t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Your goal is to collect as many mushrooms as possible. There will be 2 gnomes on each choice and you will be lead to a different forest based on which one you pick. The Gnomes will appear in the following fixed pairs: Orange & BrownGreen & PinkRed & YellowBlue & PurpleYou will have to pick one of the Gnomes to lead you to a forest. One Gnome will lead you to a dark forest and the other a bright forest.The Orange, Green, Red and Blue gnomes will lead you to the bright forest.The Brown, Pink, Yellow and Purple gnomes will take you to the dark forest.The gnomes size, hat type and position are irrelevant.

vb_textbox.text: You'll know by now the aim of the game. There are 2 key things to understand that will help you decide which Gnome to pick.The Gnomes appear in fixed pairs:Orange & BrownGreen & PinkRed & YellowBlue & PurpleTheir positions may change but they will always be in these pairs.One Gnome will take you to a Dark Forest and the other will take you to a light forest.The Orange, Green, Red and Blue gnomes will send you to the light forest.The Brown, Pink, Yellow and Purple gnomes will send you to the dark forest.The number of mushrooms will change constantly but you want to head to the forest that is giving out more. Eventually this forest will only give out a small number of mushrooms and you'll probably want to switch to the other forest at this point.NOTE: The gnomes size, hat and position are irrelevant so just focus on the colour of the gnomes and which forest it corresponds to. Remember the x5 multipliers too, they make a huge difference when you get 1 mushroom compared to 8 mushrooms.Also, can't recall if the instructions mention it but you will get some 5 minutes breaks throughout so stay focussed! Good Luck!
